messages:
jenna: Heads-up — Azure marketplace deal with Velox is blocked by a legal redline from Microsoft procurement. They won't approve PO until reseller clause is amended.

matt: Which clause? can finance sign off if we get a PO? :thinking: 

arjun: Customer wants to close this week (EOD Fri). If Azure holds the PO we lose momentum.

leo: can you paste the redline? I need the exact text.

jenna: Sure — here's the snippet Azure inserted:
```
Reseller shall not be liable for Customer data loss beyond direct damages; Customer indemnifies Reseller for third-party claims arising from use of services; Reseller & Microsoft require mutual indemnities and limitation of liability to be capped at fees paid in prior 12 months.
```

jenna: Azure procurement is insisting on the mutual indemnity + MS-specific addendum. Velox procurement pushed back on mutual indemnity.

sarah: Ops note: Azure marketplace won't accept our standard SOW attachment unless the reseller addendum is included. That's why PO isn't routed.

leo: Ok. We can accept a carveout for gross negligence and align cap to 12 months fees, but can't accept unlimited indemnity. I'll prepare a counter-redline.

matt: If legal can agree to your counter, can we still get an invoice out of band while marketplace flow is fixed? so finance can receive PO and book revenue.

sarah: Practically yes — we can do manual invoicing to Velox and mark as pending marketplace reconciliation. Need CRO approval for temporary terms.

carly: @jenna @leo I'm looped — can we get a short summary + proposed clause by noon? I'll greenlight manual invoice if risk is low.

arjun: I'll tell Velox we can do manual invoice if legal signs counter today. Otherwise we lose the week.

marketplace-bot: Azure Marketplace status: PO routing pending — reseller addendum missing (ticket #MP-4721).

jenna: Action items: 1) @leo draft counter-redline (due 12:00) 2) @carly approve temporary manual invoice (by 14:00) 3) @matt prepare manual invoice template and PR/PO mapping

leo: On it — posting draft in a minute.

matt: I'll prepare invoice template and confirm tax/VAT handling with accounting.

arjun: Thanks team — ping me when legal posts the text, I'll share with Velox.

sarah: Adding steps for marketplace ops after signature: attach addendum to Azure listing, re-route PO, and reconcile invoice.

jenna: Thanks. If we don't get sign-off today I'll escalate to VP GTM.
